headline: Congress in a holding pattern—Senate back Tuesday for judicial confirmation showdown, House pro forma Monday!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met in pro forma session on Friday, September 18, conducting no legislative business and adjourning until Tuesday.

onTheFloor.title: Confirmation of Angela Veronica Colmenero of Texas to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas
onTheFloor.status: cloture vote scheduled for 5:30 PM Tuesday

house.lastSessionSummary: The House was not in session on Friday, September 18. The chamber will reconvene in pro forma session on Monday, September 21 for procedural purposes only.
